corrected_social_circle._note: Same five-member structure as the draft social circle, with inconsistencies resolved and gaps addressed. Every correction traces back to an observation in the verification report above.

social_circle.name: Evan's Wife

background.why_close: She is Evan's main emotional anchor, household partner, and the person who helps him reality-check commitments and manage anxiety.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Direct and practical, with supportive reminders and clear reality checks when Evan is overcommitted or anxious.

shared_activities: reviewing Evan's calendar before he says yes to commitments
recent_text_topics: Whether Evan should take on another arts council commitment.
Grocery planning and household budgeting during tighter weeks.
Reminders to walk, garden, or step back when event stress is rising.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05: Evan says his wife is 'the most important person in my daily life.' Q11 says she helps keep their calendar sane. Q34 says they review the calendar before he says yes. Q44 shows she tells him to deal with conflicts factually.

social_circle.name: Mary Grant
social_circle.relationship: close art friend and arts mentor-peer

background.how_they_met: They met through local arts circles and the Van Buren Arts Council.
background.why_close: Mary invited Evan into the volunteer watercolor workshop that became a turning point for him and continues to be a trusted arts friend.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Friendly and thoughtful, focused on practical arts planning and encouragement.

social_circle.communication_frequency: weekly, more often during workshop weeks
recent_text_topics: Planning workshop sign-up sheets and supply needs.
Coordinating local art displays and room setup.
Discussing how to make arts spaces feel welcoming and inclusive.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q02 names 'Mary Grant' as the local painter who asked Evan to help coordinate a volunteer watercolor workshop. Q07 says, 'Mary Grant is a good art friend.'

background.why_close: The friendship comes from repeated Saturday hikes, shared trail routines, and easy low-pressure conversation.

shared_activities: Saturday hikes with the Ozark Trail Hiking Club
talking about knees, boots, and snacks
discussing when hiking poles are needed
recent_text_topics: Which trail is manageable if Evan's knee is sore.
Saturday meetup times, weather, and snacks.
Whether to bring poles for a steeper hike.

Planning the next family meal or holiday gathering.
Coordinating rides, meals, or check-ins when someone needs help.

Checking in after a fall, health issue, or medication question.
Coordinating parish meals, setup, or support for older members.
